known_limitations.text: Multiple recalls, including a February 2025 recall of more than 370,000 Model 3/Model Y for possible loss of power-assisted steering and an August 2025 Australian recall of 7,301 units over a window-pinch software flaw.

used_market_considerations.text: Model 3 batteries vary by plant: Panasonic 2170 NCA cells (Fremont), LG Energy Solution NMC cells (Shanghai), and CATL LFP prismatic cells for lower-cost models. It was the first EV to pass 1 million global sales (June 2021), with China as its second-largest market.

destination_market_considerations.text: The Model 3 is assembled at Fremont (US) and Gigafactory Shanghai; Shanghai-built cars are exported to Europe, the Middle East, Australia and Japan. Region-specific charging connectors include CCS2, GB/T and NACS.

parts_service_considerations.text: The Model 3 sources battery cells from Panasonic (Fremont), LG Energy Solution (Shanghai NMC) and CATL (LFP), and Tesla remediates many issues via over-the-air software updates rather than physical service visits.

known_limitations.text: The Model 3 has had numerous recalls, including 356,309 units for rear-view camera wiring (December 2021), plus OTA software recalls for intermittent tail lamps (2022), Full Self-Driving Beta (2023) and Autosteer (2023).
